detail.description: Brief visible support or exact uncertainty; no chain of thought
detail.title: Detail

region.description: Optional location within the image, e.g. left panel
region.title: Region

image_number.description: 1-based position in the supplied image sequence
image_number.title: Image Number

variant_labels.description: Labels for every visible listing variant in this image; [] if none
variant_labels.title: Variant Labels

duplicate_of.description: Earlier image number only for a redundant view; null otherwise
duplicate_of.title: Duplicate Of

evidence.description: Evidence for every positive/value observation; false needs none, null may explain uncertainty
evidence.title: Evidence

front_view.description: Identify the product’s visible front or principal face, including its actual packaging front; do not guess orientation from an ambiguous crop. Use null when uncertain.
front_view.title: Front View

logo.description: Identify a visible brand mark on the actual product or packaging; exclude watermarks, promotional overlays and branding on unrelated props. Use null when uncertain.
logo.title: Logo

human_interaction.description: Identify visible human contact with the actual product, such as holding, touching or carrying; a nearby person alone is insufficient. Use null when uncertain.
human_interaction.title: Human Interaction

rich_environment.description: Identify the product or attributable application/result in a relevant setting with visible contextual detail; a plain backdrop alone does not qualify. Use null when uncertain.
rich_environment.title: Rich Environment

contents_visible.description: Identify actual exposed formulation, solid product or contents through transparent packaging; opaque packs and printed claims do not reveal contents. Use null when uncertain.
contents_visible.title: Contents Visible

open_lid_cap.description: Identify a visibly open/removed cap or exposed dispensing tip where this subtype has one; do not infer an opening action. Use null when uncertain.
open_lid_cap.title: Open Lid Cap

texture_detail.description: Identify an attributable formulation close-up or swatch showing colour, texture or finish; do not infer composition, effects or application on another body site. Use null when uncertain.
texture_detail.title: Texture Detail

applicator_detail.description: Identify the actual visible applicator or dispensing tip; distinguish included parts from unrelated tools and do not infer a covered tip. Use null when uncertain.
applicator_detail.title: Applicator Detail

applied_on_human.description: Identify attributable lipstick colour/finish on lips, even without the container; a hand swatch or unrelated makeup does not qualify. Use null when uncertain.
applied_on_human.title: Applied On Human

multi_pack.description: Identify separate products of the same kind shown as a catalog assortment, including variants; exclude repeated views of one item, unrelated props and packaging art mistaken for units. Use null when uncertain.
multi_pack.title: Multi Pack

combo.description: Identify different product types visibly represented together as a catalog set, supported by item context; exclude unrelated props, duplicate views and packaging art mistaken for actual items. Use null when uncertain.
combo.title: Combo

ignore.description: Ignore only when neither the catalog product nor an attributable application/result or contents depiction is identifiable, or dominant text prevents assessing that evidence. Unbranded items are valid. Use null when uncertain.
ignore.title: Ignore

roles.description: Supported non-null observations assigned to this reference
roles.title: Roles

label.description: Short label such as A or B, assigned by first appearance
label.title: Label
